column3: The Hebrew says a wind set out “from the LORD” and spread the quail “over the camp”; BSB describes a wind “sent by the LORD” and says it brought the quail “near the camp.”

The Hebrew describes the least gatherer as having gathered ten homers and emphasizes spreading with a repeated verb; BSB states the minimum as “No one gathered less” and gives the spreading verb once.
The Hebrew says “before it was cut off” and describes the blow as “very great”; BSB says “before it was chewed” and “a severe plague.”
The Hebrew uses active singular “he called” and leaves the craving object unstated; BSB uses plural “they called” and adds “other food.”
The Hebrew says they “were at Hazeroth”; BSB adds the duration expression “for some time.”
